"Make a game. Roleplaying game like DnD (Dungeons and Dragons), something like adventure simulator. Player can pick the role (knight, mage, sorcerer, priest, rogue, etc just like in DnD but I want the race to be either Vampire or Dracula) first, or randomly selected using dice. After that, the story background is provided, then the player can choose one direction of the story from 2 or more choices provided, the ending or end of the story is determined depending on the choices made. And include some monsters or enemies in some options, as a risk to those options. Players can attack or defeat these monsters or enemies, can also have a negotiation chat or trick them, but the success and loss of enemy blood depends on the number of dice that come out randomly. Also include some peaceful options, with no monsters, enemies, or anything else that would make things difficult for the player.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
